Explicit unknown_dependencies must be empty. Full root materialization is therefore required by actual115 semantics; earlier sparse root checkout is unsound.

Seed variants reuse the positive root, check origin/ancestry and every source_paths regular nonsymlink file, and independently recheck assessed physical bytes/modes. source-contract variants intentionally bypass seed and get fresh root assessment. Neither source_paths nor physical assertions may be narrowed.

The separate exp worktree currently gets a full worktree add checkout, immediately followed by sparse-checkout of /tools/, /schema/, /.github/, the prompt template, /.agent/contracts/, /.agent/run_state.json and CONTROL_PREFIX. Only this transient extra materialization is the candidate. No code executes between these two calls, but final worktree index/config/readset still need equivalence proof.

one_bounded_future_measurement.preservation: Per actual command capture complete tracked/ignored/untracked physical bytes, full modes/nlinks and parent types, installed payload inventory, HEAD/tree/origin/refs/status and outside sentinel before/after using the existing capture discipline by immutable reference.
